Before you call

My suburb is not listed—can you still come?

Usually yes. Metro pages cover the wider urban area. Call 1-888-XXX-XXXX with your street address.

Why is each city only one page?

You land on emergency glass for your city. National service pages cover storefront, doors, and board-up for all of Canada.

Do you work after hours?

Yes—board-up and security work runs 24/7. Permanent glass install may follow supplier lead times.
